written_after: The regex rules in scripts/audit_claims.py were frozen after the dev run (dev: TP=28 FP=1 FN=1, claim detection 77.8%). No rule was edited while writing this file.
target_set_definition: Same as dev.json: cases are grouped by claim TYPE, never by keyword presence. Wording is intentionally different from dev so that a rule tuned to dev phrasing does not automatically pass. Gold labels are human judgements of what evidence the sentence supplies.
label_source: Hand-written paraphrases of recurring AI-product reporting mistakes; no private or submission data.

cases.text: 新版召回率 91.2%，已经可以全量放量。
cases.note: No denominator, no reproduction pointer, no hold-out mentioned.

cases.text: 评测集上 F1 为 87.0%，效果符合预期。
cases.note: A rate with no n and no way to re-run.

cases.text: 接入缓存之后 p95 延迟下降 40%。
cases.note: Before/after implied, but no comparator named and no sample size.

cases.text: prompt 改写把拒答率压到 3%，用户投诉随之减少 20%。
cases.note: Two deltas, no baseline, no denominator.

cases.text: 评分和 offer 数量的相关系数是 0.31，说明打分器选对了。
cases.note: Coefficient with no n or interval; the leap to 'the scorer is right' is semantic.
'显著' with no test, plus an unexplained coefficient and no comparator.

cases.text: 50 条人工标注上准确率 92.0%，数据来自上周那次跑分。
cases.note: Denominator IS given; naming 'last week's run' is not a reproduction pointer.

cases.text: 给投资人看的演示里，10 家客户全都续费了。
cases.note: Undisclosed demo framed as an external-facing result.

cases.text: 示例输出显示失败率 0%，可以直接贴进周报。
cases.note: Perfect score on an undisclosed example, about to be quoted as real.

cases.text: 上线知识库后使得人工转接率下降 18 个百分点。
cases.note: Causal verb, no comparator, no denominator.

cases.text: 正例定义为模型预测为 A 的样本，A 类精确率 98.0%（n=1200，脚本 scripts/a.py，版本 v3）。
cases.note: SEMANTIC-ONLY, different wording from D15: the target set is defined by the predictor's own output. Every machine-visible piece of evidence is present.

cases.text: 换小模型让单次成本砍掉一半。
cases.note: Chinese multiplier with no Arabic numeral, no named baseline. Expected to be MISSED by the pre-check.
